movelist.name: Agility
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Jump Kick
movelist.effect: If Jump Kick misses, the user loses Hit Points equal to 1/4th of their Max Hit Points. A failure to hit due to a Move with the Shield keyword does not count as a miss. This Move cannot be used if Gravity is in effect.

movelist.name: Bounce
movelist.effect: The user first Shifts, gaining a +1 Bonus to Movement Speed and to their Jump Capabilities. After the user Shifts, they may attack with Bounce. The target becomes Vulnerable, and is Paralyzed on 16+.

movelist.name: Silver Wind
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Feint
movelist.effect: If a foe uses a Move with the Shield Keyword in response to one of your actions, you may activate Feint to cause the triggering Move to Fail. Feint is activated as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Stomp
movelist.effect: Stomp Flinches the target on 15+. If the target is at least one size category smaller than the user, Stomp deals an additional 10 damage.

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.trigger: The user’s Damaging Attack causes an
abilities.effect: The user receives +1 Combat Stage in their highest non-HP stat.

abilities.name: Vanguard
abilities.effect: The user gains a +5 Bonus to all Damage Rolls against targets with an initiative lower than itself that have not yet acted that round (having Ante’d up your Action via an Interrupt or similar on a previous round does not count as having acted that round).

abilities.name: Lightning Kicks
abilities.effect: The user may activate this Ability to use any Move with “Kick” in the name as a Priority Move, and gain a +4 Bonus to the attack’s Accuracy Roll.
